scope: weak ensemble convergence gate; production claims also require independent reruns and threshold sensitivity
size_scaling_convention: Global at-least-one-event probabilities are extensive and need not become size independent. Certification compares per-cell event intensity and local wall descriptors; global probabilities remain reported observables.
save_cadence_rule: subsample identical fine-cadence paths; require mechanism labels unchanged and FPT error <= one coarse interval
